skill_name: Explain the most common methods of making money online
workflow: The most common methods of making money online are affiliate marketing, paid surveys, ecommerce, email marketing, content creation, blog advertisements, and freelance work. Affiliate marketing involves promoting products or services for a commission when someone purchases them through your affiliate link.
